method.design: 12 shared artifact checkpoints, each with 3 continuation and 3 fresh-context forks
method.budget_note: Total budgets were matched within checkpoints except cp5mid-r1 (reset 4k nominal versus continue 10k). Primary metrics use only the first fork-own episode or first novel correct artifact and therefore precede total-budget truncation.
method.parent_definition: Novelty is relative to the live workspace artifact in the highest-numbered ws_ep snapshot, which is exactly what CopilotRetry restores. Success means beating the checkpoint's historical incumbent best. The live artifact can be worse than the incumbent when the snapshot captures an in-flight experiment.
method.artifact_distance: Direct parent-to-child distance is Bray-Curtis distance on Python token unigram and adjacent-bigram counts after removing the fixed benchmark harness. Zero is identical and one is disjoint. Cosine distance on the same raw feature vectors is reported as a sensitivity representation.
method.first_edit_conditioning: First-score and code-edit similarity exclude pairs where either fork produced no novel correct artifact; empty-empty is not treated as similarity.
method.inference: 95% intervals resample checkpoints; p-values use exact paired sign flips over checkpoint-level arm differences.

sensitivity_without_cp5mid.reason: cp5mid-r1 used a lower reset budget; first-move metrics precede truncation, but this is the conservative checkpoint-level exclusion.
